senses: An indefinite article marking a single, nonspecific count noun.

senses: At a higher level or position than.

senses: To combine quantities or include something extra.

senses: Later than in time; following.

senses: Living; not dead.

senses: In addition; too.

senses: A person from whom one is descended.
